claim.statement: GitHub's dated 1 April 2026 changelog explicitly states that Copilot cloud agent was formerly known as Copilot coding agent and expands the service beyond pull-request-only workflows to research, planning and branch-based code changes.

source.title: Research, plan, and code with Copilot cloud agent
source.locator: Dated heading; introduction; More control over when you open a pull request

limitations: The dated entry anchors publisher naming and feature state, not an immutable service build.
The catalog did not exercise research, planning, branch or pull-request routes.
unknowns: The backend deployment and model set corresponding to the naming milestone are unknown.
Whether every older reference to Copilot coding agent maps without exception to the current service is not established beyond the explicit publisher statement.

relationships.note: The later publisher source supplies the current name and explicitly preserves the former-name lineage; it does not rewrite the earlier GA behavior as current.
